set -euo pipefail; WORK=/tmp/t4-wp901-g4-two-process-a1; rm -rf "$WORK"; mkdir -p "$WORK"; git clone -q --filter=blob:none --no-checkout https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein-2.0.git "$WORK/f2"; cd "$WORK/f2"; git checkout -q 7ff46725930ffa9e452e7ed89537dde8e828259a; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 7ff46725930ffa9e452e7ed89537dde8e828259a; export PYTHONPATH=src:.; cat > "$WORK/process_a.py" <<'PY'
from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import asdict
import hashlib, json, os, sqlite3, sys
from pathlib import Path
from frankenstein2.causal_identity import CausalIdentity
from frankenstein2.persistent_agency_kernel import CanonicalPersistentAgencyStore, advance_checkpoint
from frankenstein2.restart_recovery_continuation import PersistedRestartEvidence
from frankenstein2.restart_recovery_source_authentication import causal_identity_ref
from frankenstein2.whole_loop_persistence_integration import persist_sealed_successor_and_readback
from frankenstein2.whole_persistent_loop import LoopOutcomeEvidence, NO_EFFECT, required_reentry_refs, seal_whole_persistent_loop
from state.unifieddb_identity import fingerprint_unifieddb, resolve_unifieddb_path
from tests.test_whole_persistent_loop import fixture_components

mode, root_s, meta_s = sys.argv[1:4]
root = Path(root_s); meta_path = Path(meta_s); home = root / 'home'; home.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
db = root / 'canonical' / 'unified.db'; db.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
c = sqlite3.connect(db); c.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS f2_target_bootstrap(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)'); c.commit(); c.close()
env = os.environ.copy(); env['FRANKENSTEIN2_DB'] = str(db)
resolution = resolve_unifieddb_path(env=env, home=home); fingerprint = fingerprint_unifieddb(resolution.path)
store = CanonicalPersistentAgencyStore.open(resolution=resolution, fingerprint=fingerprint); store.initialize_schema()
current, frame, contract, grid_plan, gwt_seal, gwt_evidence, decision, _old_outcome, _old_next = fixture_components()
causal = CausalIdentity(session_id='t4-wp901-target', agent_id='gpt56sol', task_id='wp901-two-process', turn_id=mode, causal_id='causal-t4-wp901-'+mode, generation=current.generation + 1, parent_causal_id='causal-t4-wp901-parent')
causal_ref = causal_identity_ref(causal)
outcome = LoopOutcomeEvidence(outcome_id='outcome-t4-wp901-'+mode, status=NO_EFFECT, provenance_refs=(causal_ref, 'target:t4:wp901:'+mode))
reentry_refs = required_reentry_refs(current_checkpoint=current, frame=frame, contract=contract, plan=grid_plan, gwt_seal=gwt_seal, decision=decision, outcome=outcome)
next_checkpoint = advance_checkpoint(current, checkpoint_id='checkpoint-t4-wp901-'+mode, pulse_id='pulse-t4-wp901-'+mode, observation_id='observation-t4-wp901-'+mode, provenance_refs=tuple(sorted(set(reentry_refs) | {causal_ref})))
seal = seal_whole_persistent_loop(seal_id='whole-loop-t4-wp901-'+mode, generation=current.generation, current_checkpoint=current, frame=frame, contract=contract, plan=grid_plan, gwt_seal=gwt_seal, gwt_evidence=gwt_evidence, decision=decision, outcome=outcome, next_checkpoint=next_checkpoint, provenance_refs=(causal_ref, 'target:t4:wp901:seal:'+mode))
evidence = PersistedRestartEvidence(evidence_id='restart-evidence-t4-wp901-'+mode, source_checkpoint_id=next_checkpoint.checkpoint_id, source_checkpoint_generation=next_checkpoint.generation, source_checkpoint_sha256=next_checkpoint.sha256(), whole_loop_seal_id=seal.seal_id, whole_loop_seal_sha256=seal.sha256(), outcome_status=outcome.status, outcome_sha256=outcome.sha256(), unfinished_work_refs=('work:t4:alpha',), completed_work_refs=(), effect_attempt_refs=(), provenance_refs=(causal_ref, 'receipt:wp900', 'receipt:wp206'))
store.write_checkpoint(current)
meta = {'mode': mode, 'db': str(db.resolve()), 'evidence': asdict(evidence), 'current_id': current.checkpoint_id, 'current_sha256': current.sha256(), 'next_id': next_checkpoint.checkpoint_id, 'next_sha256': next_checkpoint.sha256(), 'next_previous': next_checkpoint.previous_checkpoint_id, 'seal_sha256': seal.sha256(), 'source_commit': '7ff46725930ffa9e452e7ed89537dde8e828259a'}
meta_path.write_text(json.dumps(meta, sort_keys=True), encoding='utf-8')
if mode == 'normal':
    ev = persist_sealed_successor_and_readback(store, seal=seal, next_checkpoint=next_checkpoint)
    print(json.dumps({'phase':'A','mode':mode,'same_process_adapter_sha256':ev.sha256(),'next_sha256':next_checkpoint.sha256()}, sort_keys=True))
    store.close()
else:
    original = CanonicalPersistentAgencyStore.load_checkpoint
    calls = {'n': 0}
    def crash_before_successor_readback(self, checkpoint_id):
        calls['n'] += 1
        if calls['n'] == 2:
            os._exit(0)
        return original(self, checkpoint_id)
    CanonicalPersistentAgencyStore.load_checkpoint = crash_before_successor_readback
    persist_sealed_successor_and_readback(store, seal=seal, next_checkpoint=next_checkpoint)
    raise SystemExit('CRASH_HOOK_DID_NOT_FIRE')
PY
cat > "$WORK/process_b.py" <<'PY'
from __future__ import annotations
import json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
from frankenstein2.causal_authority_binding import UnifiedDBAuthorityRef
from frankenstein2.persistent_agency_kernel import CanonicalPersistentAgencyStore
from frankenstein2.restart_recovery_continuation import PersistedRestartEvidence
from frankenstein2.restart_recovery_persisted_row_load_attestation import CANONICAL_UNIFIEDDB_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT_REF, CANONICAL_UNIFIEDDB_AUTHORITY_SOURCE, load_checkpoint_with_persisted_row_receipt
from state.unifieddb_identity import fingerprint_unifieddb, resolve_unifieddb_path
meta = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding='utf-8')); db = Path(meta['db']); home = db.parents[1] / 'home'
env = os.environ.copy(); env['FRANKENSTEIN2_DB'] = str(db)
resolution = resolve_unifieddb_path(env=env, home=home); fingerprint = fingerprint_unifieddb(resolution.path)
store = CanonicalPersistentAgencyStore.open(resolution=resolution, fingerprint=fingerprint)
evidence = PersistedRestartEvidence(**meta['evidence'])
authority = UnifiedDBAuthorityRef(receipt_ref=CANONICAL_UNIFIEDDB_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT_REF, canonical_source=CANONICAL_UNIFIEDDB_AUTHORITY_SOURCE, fingerprint_schema='FRANKENSTEIN2_UNIFIEDDB_FINGERPRINT/v2')
checkpoint, receipt = load_checkpoint_with_persisted_row_receipt(evidence, store=store, unifieddb_authority=authority)
assert checkpoint.checkpoint_id == meta['next_id']; assert checkpoint.sha256() == meta['next_sha256']; assert checkpoint.previous_checkpoint_id == meta['current_id']; assert receipt.predecessor_checkpoint_sha256 == meta['current_sha256']; assert receipt.canonical_db_path == str(db.resolve()); assert receipt.db_device == store.db_device; assert receipt.db_inode == store.db_inode
print(json.dumps({'phase':'B','mode':meta['mode'],'fresh_process':True,'checkpoint_id':checkpoint.checkpoint_id,'checkpoint_sha256':checkpoint.sha256(),'previous_checkpoint_id':checkpoint.previous_checkpoint_id,'predecessor_sha256':receipt.predecessor_checkpoint_sha256,'row_evidence_sha256':receipt.row_evidence_sha256,'db_device':receipt.db_device,'db_inode':receipt.db_inode,'store_authority_receipt_sha256':receipt.store_authority_receipt_sha256,'runtime_credit_claimed_by_component':receipt.as_dict()['runtime_credit']}, sort_keys=True))
store.close()
PY
python3 -m py_compile "$WORK/process_a.py" "$WORK/process_b.py"; rm -rf "$WORK/normal" "$WORK/crash"; python3 "$WORK/process_a.py" normal "$WORK/normal" "$WORK/normal-meta.json"; python3 "$WORK/process_b.py" "$WORK/normal-meta.json"; python3 "$WORK/process_a.py" crash "$WORK/crash" "$WORK/crash-meta.json"; python3 "$WORK/process_b.py" "$WORK/crash-meta.json"; echo T4_WP901_TWO_PROCESS_TARGET_DISCRIMINATOR_PASS
